title: Two Perplexity Sonar models join the text API
summary:
Two Sonar models and a text-model discovery endpoint arrived alongside clearer Pollen estimates and a round of streaming and site repairs.

Perplexity Sonar and Sonar Reasoning were added as `perplexity-fast` and `perplexity-reasoning`, both with tool support. Response validation was also adjusted to accept the empty `finish_reason` values these models can return in regular and streaming completions.

An unauthenticated text-model listing endpoint was added, and the main site's generation requests and model lists were moved toward Enter's API. The image slideshow now displays API error messages rather than broken images. A subsequent configuration edit introduced duplicate declarations that prevent the frontend from compiling; the docs also gained a Quick Start.

Enter gained text and image model pricing tables showing rates and estimated outputs per Pollen for different workloads. Separately, tier requirements were removed from service definitions, and the default queue limit became three requests per interval for all users. The table changes alone do not establish a change in charges or access.
